fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: On a Central grid map, Flora is at (-3, -2) and the mooncake stall at (2, 10). What is the straight-line distance?
questions.q_zh: 中环坐标图上 Flora 在 (-3, -2)，月饼摊在 (2, 10)，直线距离是多少？

questions.q_en: On a Central grid map, Flora is at (-2, -2) and the mooncake stall at (6, 13). What is the straight-line distance?
questions.q_zh: 中环坐标图上 Flora 在 (-2, -2)，月饼摊在 (6, 13)，直线距离是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The number of lanterns is a² + 5a. Find it when a = 2.
questions.q_zh: 灯笼数量是 a² + 5a，求 a = 2 时的值。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Peak, Flora sees a far lantern-bearer's arm move, then hears a call. The delay is because ____.
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 先看见远处提灯人的手臂动了，然后才听见叫声。有延迟，是因为____。
choices: light reaches her faster than sound
skates store the sound in the wheels
choices_zh: 轮滑把声音存在轮子里
questions.explain_en: Light travels much faster than sound.

questions.subject: hongkong
questions.q_en: Flora's skate from Central along the harbour and up to the Peak follows which pair of scene changes in this level?
questions.q_zh: Flora 从中环滑到维港，再上太平山，这一关的两段场景切换是哪一对？
choices: Central to a subway depot only
Central to harbour, then harbour to Peak
Peak to desert, then desert to farm
Harbour to glacier, then glacier to cave
choices_zh: 中环到维港，再从维港到山顶
山顶到沙漠，再从沙漠到农田
维港到冰川，再从冰川到山洞
questions.explain_en: The path is Central, then the harbour, then the Peak.
questions.explain_zh: 路线是中环、维港、太平山。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A bird over the harbour rises with height h = -3t² + 15t (in metres). What is h at t = 4?
questions.q_zh: 维港上空一只鸟的高度是 h = -3t² + 15t（单位：米），t = 4 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Two mooncake sellers at the Peak: one charges 4 + 8x yuan, the other 49 + 3x yuan for x mooncakes. For what x do they cost the same?
questions.q_zh: 太平山两家卖月饼：一家 x 块收 4 + 8x 元，另一家收 49 + 3x 元。x 是多少时两家价钱一样？
questions.qtype_zh: 两边都有未知数的方程

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes are set out in waves at the Peak: 4 at first, and the number set out multiplies by 2 each wave. How many are set out in wave 7, after 6 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼一波波摆出：开始 4 块，每一波是上一波的 2 倍。乘了 6 次之后（第 7 波）摆出多少块？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a city grid (units of 10 m), the harbour railing is at (-1, 1) and Flora's red taxi is at (7, 16). What is the straight-line distance in grid units?
questions.q_zh: 在市区坐标图上（单位 10 米），维港栏杆在 (-1, 1)，Flora 那辆红色的士在 (7, 16)，两点直线距离是几个单位？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a lamp post at the harbour, a rope runs to a point 12 m along the deck; the pole is 9 m tall. How long is the rope from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 维港一根灯柱高 9 米，从杆顶拉一根绳子到地面离杆脚 12 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 200 visitors watched the trams from the harbour. This year there are 15% more. How many visitors are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年有 200 位游客在维港看叮叮车，今年多了 15%，今年有多少人？
